equation: partial_t u - Delta u + (u dot nabla)u + nabla p = 0, div u = 0 on R^3, viscosity 1 and zero force
lemma: For a KNSS maximum-normalized record zoom, the subsequential limit extends smoothly through record-centered scaled time zero, the limits k->infinity and s->0- commute locally there, their common record-time trace is nonzero, and the original solution carries a scale-invariant positive local L3 mass on balls of radius comparable to M_k^-1. This says nothing by itself about the physical terminal time T, which is the mobile scaled endpoint B_k.

status_vocabulary.SOURCE: stated in the cited primary source
status_vocabulary.SOURCE_PLUS_SCALING: source estimate restarted on a uniform parabolic interval and rescaled algebraically
status_vocabulary.DERIVATION: laboratory implication, not attributed verbatim to a paper
status_vocabulary.COUNTERPROFILE: exact adverse family used only to test necessity of a gate

normalization.past_bound: |v_k(y,s)|<=gamma_k for s<=0, with gamma_k->1 and gamma_k<=2 eventually
normalization.past_endpoint: A_k=-M_k^2 t_k tends to minus infinity
normalization.record_time: scaled s=0 corresponds to physical t=t_k, not to T

properties.unforced_viscous_ns: standard incompressible Navier-Stokes with viscosity one
properties.maximum_record_zoom: the scale and center are selected by the KNSS running maximum construction
properties.uniform_past_velocity_bound: the normalized fields satisfy |v_k|<=2 on every fixed past strip for all large k
properties.mild_restart: the normalized solution satisfies the Oseen/Leray formula between finite scaled times
properties.uniform_record_time_spatial_derivative: the gradients at and immediately before record-centered s=0 have a k-independent bound
properties.uniform_record_time_derivative: partial_s v_k has a k-independent bound near record-centered s=0
properties.same_centered_sequence: all limits refer to the same subsequence and the same record-centered time

O1_RECORD_NORMALIZATION.conclusion: M_k tends to infinity, |v_k|<=gamma_k on the past, and |v_k(0,0)|=1

O2_UNIFORM_RECORD_SPATIAL_DERIVATIVES.source: KNSS 2009, Proposition 4.1 restarted a fixed scaled time before zero
O2_UNIFORM_RECORD_SPATIAL_DERIVATIVES.conclusion: for every spatial order m, sup_k sup_(-delta<=s<=0)||nabla^m v_k(s)||_infinity is finite

O3_UNIFORM_RECORD_TIME_DERIVATIVE.source: KNSS 2009, Proposition 4.1 with one time derivative

O4_RECORD_TIME_COMPACTNESS.source: Arzela-Ascoli using O2 and O3, consistent with KNSS Lemma 6.1
O4_RECORD_TIME_COMPACTNESS.conclusion: after a subsequence v_k converges in C^m_local through s=0 to a bounded ancient mild v

O6_LIMITS_COMMUTE.source: uniform record-time modulus from O3 plus local convergence from O4
O6_LIMITS_COMMUTE.conclusion: at record-centered s=0, lim_(s->0-)lim_(k->infinity)<v_k(s),phi>=lim_(k->infinity)lim_(s->0-)<v_k(s),phi>=<v(0),phi>; this is not a physical terminal trace at T

O7_COMMON_RECORD_VALUE_NONZERO.source: point normalization and record-time C^0_local convergence
O7_COMMON_RECORD_VALUE_NONZERO.conclusion: |v(0,0)|=1, so one compactly supported vector test has <v(0),phi> nonzero at the record-centered time

O8_CRITICAL_L3_CONCENTRATION.source: uniform gradient bound, point normalization and the scale-invariance of local L3 mass
O8_CRITICAL_L3_CONCENTRATION.conclusion: if ||nabla v_k(0)||_infinity<=G then integral_(B_(1/(2G M_k))(x_k)) |u(x,t_k)|^3 dx >= pi/(48 G^3)

O9_UNIFORM_LOCAL_L3_REGULARITY_CRITERION.source: contrapositive of O8 and the L-infinity blow-up alternative; compare Constantin 2023, condition (23) and Theorem 2
O9_UNIFORM_LOCAL_L3_REGULARITY_CRITERION.conclusion: if sup_(t near T,x) integral_(B_r(x))|u(t)|^3 tends to zero as r tends to zero, then T is not a finite maximal time; this full equi-integrability hypothesis is stronger than Constantin's already known fixed-threshold continuation condition and is not claimed as a new criterion

AFFINE_PRESSURE_TERMINAL_LAYER.description: u_k(x,s)=exp(k^2 s)e_1 and p_k(x,s)=-k^2 exp(k^2 s)x_1 on s<=0 solve the classical unforced PDE, but are not mild; the two endpoint limits are 0 and e_1

TRANSLATED_PACKET.description: a fixed compact divergence-free packet translated to infinity converges to zero in distributions but loses the centered point normalization and is not one record-zoom trajectory

HIGH_FREQUENCY_SLICES.description: bounded divergence-free slices sin(k x_1)e_2 have no uniform gradient bound and are not a single mild record-zoom trajectory

SPATIALLY_CONSTANT_MILD_SOLUTION.description: u=e_1 is an exact bounded ancient mild solution; all record-time limits commute and the common trace is nonzero, but it is not produced here by a finite-time maximum-record blow-up
